prompt:
You are editing a photo of handwritten/printed C code for a competitive-programming prefix-sum problem.
Keep the same visual style, handwriting/print look, lighting, framing, and paper/background.
Edit only the code content to create a realistic student-written variant.
Do not add explanations, labels, watermarks, or extra non-code text.
Return an edited image only.

Required edit:
Produce a visibly flawed program with both syntax and logic mistakes that would fail compilation under gcc -std=c11.
